As a token of our appreciation for your continued loyalty, the first fifty customers through our doors will receive a complimentary gift bag filled with samples and refreshments. Please note that all sale purchases are final and cannot be returned or exchanged. We encourage everyone to arrive early to secure the best selection. Thank you for shopping with us, and we look forward to seeing you this weekend.

In the meantime, please refrain from sending large file attachments via email to prevent further congestion on the backup server. If your specific task requires immediate internet access, please contact the IT helpdesk directly for temporary workarounds. We apologize for any inconvenience this temporary disruption may cause to your morning schedule.

This will help us target our demographic more effectively and avoid unnecessary spending. Let us reconvene next Monday morning to discuss your feedback and make any necessary adjustments to the schedule. Your hard work and dedication to this initiative are greatly appreciated by the executive board.

Please be advised that we will be performing routine server maintenance tonight starting at 10 PM. During this window, you may experience intermittent connection issues with the internal network and shared drives. To prevent any data loss, we strongly recommend that you save all your ongoing work and properly log out of your terminals before leaving the office today. The system is expected to be fully operational by tomorrow morning at 6 AM. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your cooperation in helping us maintain our network security and performance. If you encounter any unexpected issues tomorrow, please submit a ticket through the online helpdesk portal. Thank you and have a wonderful evening.

When you arrive at our service counter, please remember to bring your valid driver's license and a major credit card so we can quickly process the paperwork and have you on your way. You will just need to sign a revised rental agreement reflecting the vehicle change. If your travel schedule changes, please notify us as soon as possible. Safe travels.

questions.text: Where does the speaker work?
questions.explanation: Người gọi nhắc đến việc nhận xe ô tô đã đặt trước tại quầy dịch vụ.

questions.text: What type of vehicle is being provided?
questions.explanation: Do dòng xe hạng trung khách đặt đã hết, công ty nâng cấp miễn phí lên xe SUV.

questions.text: What must the customer do at the counter?
questions.explanation: Khách cần ký hợp đồng thuê xe sửa đổi vì loại xe đã thay đổi.

groups.transcript: Hi team, this is Robert calling with an important update regarding the upcoming product launch event scheduled for next Thursday. As you know, we have been coordinating with the marketing department to finalize all the promotional displays and media kits. We decided to hold our final coordination meeting off-site at the Grand Horizon Hotel conference room instead of the main office, to give everyone a better feel for the venue layout. The meeting will start promptly at 9 AM and is expected to run until noon. Please review the attached agenda in your emails and confirm your attendance with my assistant by tomorrow at 12 PM so we can arrange adequate seating and catering. Your input and dedication to this project have been fantastic, and I look forward to a successful launch.

questions.text: What event is being discussed?
questions.explanation: Đoạn ghi âm thảo luận về việc chuẩn bị cho sự kiện ra mắt sản phẩm sắp tới của công ty.

questions.text: Where will the upcoming meeting take place?
questions.explanation: Cuộc họp được tổ chức tại phòng hội nghị của khách sạn Grand Horizon thay vì văn phòng chính.

questions.text: What are listeners asked to do by tomorrow noon?
questions.explanation: Người gọi yêu cầu đồng nghiệp xác nhận sự tham gia của họ trước trưa mai.
